notes.title: Alpha 1 Is Here!
notes.content:
The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here – [b]the Alpha 1 test for 3XO launches on October 25[/b]! We’re beyond excited to welcome our early community members to the next phase of our journey, and we’ve got plenty of surprises in store.

This first look at 3XO is a Halloween-themed experience, blending the spooky vibes of the season with synthwave, sci-fi, and all the cyberspace goodness you’ve come to expect from us.

Alpha 1 will go live on [b]Friday, October 25th at 3:00 pm EST[/b]. Servers will go back down at 3 am EST each night. It will run until [b]Sunday, November 3rd at 3:00 am EST[/b].

[h2]Alpha 1 Event Schedule[/h2]
We could just open the servers and that's it. But where's the fun in that? Let's party!

Our Alpha 1 test will be a huge event, with lots of in-game surprises and hidden easter eggs, as well as a full calendar of games, contests, and other exciting events! Here's the full schedule:

Full Event Calendar

[h2]DJ Timeslots[/h2]
What's a party without music? We are officially opening up sign-ups for all you awesome DJs to spin some tunes during Alpha 1.

To sign up, contact Reigning Sun (via DM, email, or opening a ticket on Discord) and tell me what timeslot(s) you're interested in. We'll then figure out a good time for us to quickly listen to your audio stream to make sure it's good quality audio.

To view all of the available timeslots, please see the Alpha 1 Announcement post on our official website.

[h1]We Need Testers![/h1]
As we prepare to launch our Alpha 1 test on October 25, we’re calling on all of you to not just play, but to test. This early phase of 3XO is where we need your help the most. Our game is built to be an expansive, player-driven experience, but in order to reach its full potential, we need dedicated testers who are willing to dive deep, find those hidden bugs, and send us detailed reports.

Being a tester isn’t just about having fun in the game (though we know you will). It’s about paying attention to those quirks and glitches, discovering what works and what doesn’t, and offering constructive feedback that helps us improve 3XO. From broken animations to server issues, every bug you catch and every piece of feedback you send us will push the game one step closer to perfection.

Our goal is to build a seamless, immersive cyberspace experience, and that means ironing out every wrinkle with your help. So, whether you spot a bug, find a feature that isn’t working quite right, or simply have an idea on how to make the game better – let us know. Your voice matters, and we’re counting on you to help us shape the future of 3XO!

[h2]How You Can Help: Becoming a Valuable Alpha Tester[/h2]
Testing a game in Alpha isn’t just about enjoying the early access experience—it’s about helping us make the game better. We need dedicated testers who are willing to explore every feature, try out different settings, and, most importantly, report any bugs they encounter. Your feedback is critical in helping us fine-tune 3XO and turn it into the ultimate social sandbox experience.
[h3]
Reporting Bugs[/h3]
We rely on detailed bug reports to find and fix issues in the game. Whether you experience a glitch in an animation, an unexpected crash, or something that just doesn’t feel right, letting us know about these issues as specifically as possible is key. When submitting reports, please include the following details:

[list]
[*] What happened? Describe the bug or issue.
[*] Where did it happen? Provide the location, context, or system (e.g., Avatar Editor, Halloween Party World).
[*] How did it happen? Share the steps you took right before the bug occurred.
[/list]

[h3]Providing Feedback[/h3]
Beyond bug reports, we value your feedback on game features and overall user experience. Let us know what works well and what could be improved. Are the controls intuitive? Is the chat system easy to use? Every piece of feedback, no matter how small, helps us identify areas for improvement and prioritize future updates.

[h3]Play How You Want, But Explore Everything[/h3]
While we encourage you to have fun during Alpha 1, we also need you to test thoroughly. Don’t just stick to the features you’re excited about—try out everything. Explore the avatar customization options, check out the Halloween Party World, dance, chat, use the emotes, and adjust settings. The more features you try, the more potential bugs you’ll uncover, and the more feedback you’ll be able to provide.

By becoming a proactive tester, you’ll help shape the future of 3XO and ensure that the game is as polished and enjoyable as possible when it launches for everyone. Thank you for your dedication—we couldn’t do this without you!

[h1]What WILL Be in Alpha 1[/h1]
Our Alpha 1 build will focus on delivering the core features of 3XO. While we have many more features already developed and ready to go, this phase of testing is designed to target specific elements that we want detailed feedback on. By focusing solely on the core features, we can ensure the feedback and bug reports we receive are streamlined and actionable, allowing us to make rapid improvements.

Here’s a breakdown of every feature you’ll get to experience in Alpha 1:

[h3]Full Avatar Editor[/h3]
One of the most exciting parts of Alpha 1 is the Full Avatar Editor. You’ll have access to a wide array of customization options for your character, from clothing choices to animation previews. Improved camera controls will make it easier to fine-tune your look, and we’ve packed in tons of new features to experiment with. Keep an eye out for an upcoming Dev Blog where we’ll show off all the exciting new tools in the editor!

[h3]Halloween Party World[/h3]
To celebrate the season, we’ve built a super cool Halloween-themed world just for Alpha 1 testers! This party world is filled with hidden easter eggs, secrets, and other cool surprises for you to discover. It’s the perfect place to show off your avatar, socialize, and explore a spooky yet vibrant virtual environment.

[h3]Dancing[/h3]
You’ll be able to show off your moves with our selection of dance animations. While the full roster of dances isn’t ready just yet, there’s already a decent variety included in Alpha 1. Expect even more dances to be added as we clean up and refine additional animations in the future.

[h3]Social Emotes[/h3]
Along with dancing, we’ve packed Alpha 1 with a range of social emotes. These will help you interact with other players, and much like the dances, we’ll be expanding this library as we continue to work on new animations.

[h3]Chatting and Profiles[/h3]
Of course, what’s a social game without chatting? The chat system will be live and functional in Alpha 1, allowing you to message and interact with fellow players. We’ve also included Profiles, where you can show off details about your avatar. Profiles will continue to evolve, with more features being added in Alpha 2.

[h3]Settings[/h3]
Lastly, you’ll have access to a fully functional Settings menu where you can adjust your graphics, audio, user interface, and other game settings to customize your experience.

[h1]What WON'T Be in Alpha 1[/h1]
As with any early test, there are a few features that won’t make it into Alpha 1 but are coming soon. The core focus of this phase is to test the essential systems, so many of the more advanced social features and customization options will debut in Alpha 2 and beyond. But don’t worry – if a feature you’re excited about isn’t in Alpha 1, the next testing phase is right around the corner!

Here’s a list of the main features that will not be available in Alpha 1:

[h3]Circles (Guilds)[/h3]
Our version of guilds, known as Circles, will not be part of Alpha 1. Circles will play a big role in how players organize and socialize in 3XO, but this system will officially roll out in Alpha 2.

[h3]Permissions System[/h3]
The Permissions system, which allows you to control who can interact with your avatar (e.g., auto-accept or deny animation requests), will also be introduced in Alpha 2. This is crucial for social interactions, and we want to ensure it’s polished before release.

[h3]Friends/Ignore Lists[/h3]
Although it may seem like a basic feature, Friends and Ignore Lists are closely tied to our larger social framework. These lists will be integrated with the database changes we’re making for Alpha 2.

[h3]World Editor[/h3]
One of the most anticipated features, the World Editor, won’t be available until Beta 1. This tool will allow players to create and customize their own worlds within 3XO, but it’s still in development and will be released once it’s ready for broader testing.

[h3]Shop & Monetization (VIP, etc.)[/h3]
While the Shop and other monetization features like VIP tiers are in the works, these won’t be a part of Alpha 1. Expect them to arrive during Beta 2 once we’ve solidified the game’s core systems.

[h3]Partnered Animations[/h3]
Now, we know this might be disappointing for some, but partnered animations, including sex and couples dances, won’t be in Alpha 1. We’ve run into challenges with our animation systems, particularly with IK targeting for avatars of different heights. This is a complex system that we’re actively working to improve, and any feedback we receive at this stage would likely be irrelevant, as we plan to overhaul it soon. Since this is also technically a social feature, we’ve made the decision to delay partnered animations until Alpha 2. We want to make sure this system is flawless before bringing it to you.


[h1]How to Get Access to Alpha 1[/h1]
Excited to jump into Alpha 1 and help shape the future of 3XO? Gaining access is easy! To participate in the Alpha 1 test, all you need to do is purchase the Fetishist tier or higher through our official website or on Itch.io. This exclusive tier not only grants you access to Alpha 1 but also comes with special in-game perks and cosmetics.

[h2]Where to Purchase[/h2]
[list]
[*] Official Website: Head over to our [url=https://3xo.io/shop]Shop[/url] and select the Fetishist tier or higher to unlock your Alpha 1 access. It’s your direct pass to joining our community of early testers and influencers.
[*] Itch.io: Alternatively, you can visit [url=https://blacklotusgames.itch.io/3xo]Itch.io[/url] and purchase the Fetishist tier there. Both platforms offer the same perks and benefits, so feel free to choose whichever is most convenient for you.
[/list]

[h2]Why the Fetishist Tier?[/h2]
By purchasing the Fetishist tier, you’re not just getting early access to 3XO—you’re supporting the ongoing development of the game. This tier includes a range of exclusive rewards like custom in-game cosmetics, early access to future updates, and direct involvement in our testing community. Plus, you'll be helping us refine the game and bring it closer to its full release.

So, what are you waiting for? Become a Fetishist today, and we’ll see you in the Alpha 1 test on October 25!

notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Masculine Character Presets
notes.content:
One of the nice things about 3XO is that, while there's practically unlimited levels of customization, you can create a great-looking avatar with just one click by using a [b]Character Preset[/b].

What the heck is a Character Preset? It lets you click one single button to automatically apply a Head Shape, Body Shape, Skin Texture, and even hair and makeup—all without having to tweak any other settings. You can also mix and match them to get more dynamic results.

So what sexy, cute, and/or handsome presets can you expect to be available in 3XO? To start with, we'll have all of the official DAZ 3D characters available—Victoria 9, Michael 9, etc. And then over time, we'll add characters created by 3rd-party artists and even from the community!

Here's a preview of ALL 15 of the [b]masculine[/b] presets which will be available in the upcoming Alpha 1 test, and will be available free for all players at launch. With one click, your avatar can look exactly like any of these presets without any other customization required. And you can also mix masculine and feminine body shapes or presets together to make some really interesting avatars!

notes.title: Character Editor Demo v2 Now Available
notes.content:
After a long wait, the Character Editor Demo has finally been updated! It now has _almost_ all the features that will be in the full game. You can download it now and test out all the wonderful new features and customizations! Download link is at the end of this post, or find it on Steam.

[h1]Version 2 - Updated[/h1]

This new "Version 2" of the Character Editor is the final version of the Demo, but the Character Editor itself will still be updated before the full release of 3XO.

This updated version includes just about all the features that will be included in the full game. Read on the learn what these new features are.

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

In addition to the [b]hundreds[/b] of advanced shaping options that Version 1 of the demo had to offer, you can now customize your character with the following features:

[list]
[*]Base Shape Presets for Head and Body
[*]Skin Color and Textures
[*]Hair Styles and Hair Colors
[*]Eye Color
[*]Makeup!
[*]Tattoos!
[*]Save & Load Updates
[/list]

[h3]Head and Body Presets[/h3]

A [b]lot[/b]of you tested Version 1 of the demo and you gave us a [b]lot[/b] of feedback! One of the most common bits of feedback was that there were far too many advanced shaping options and it was overwhelming for some users. That was to be expected. We always planned on having "base" preset shapes for the Head and Body, so that you could have an attractive character with just one click, and not need to mess with any of those more expert-level shaping options.

Well, the base shape presets are now available! We chose some of our favorite DAZ 3D models and included them in the demo. With just one click, you can set your body to be that of a muscular hunk or a sexy femme fatale.

You can choose to use a full Preset Head or full Preset Face, or leave it as the default shape. This is what we call the "Basic Tier" of customization. It's good for people who just want to pick a good-looking body or face and just get into the game.

It is [b]highly[/b] recommended that players stick with these "base" shape presets, and maybe the individual shape presets for things like Ears, Nose, etc. Tweaking the hundreds of advanced shape sliders is only for the most patient and careful of players.

[h3]Skin Color and Texture[/h3]

Now you can create your character to truly represent yourself and your ethnicity by choosing from dozens of gorgeous 4K skin textures, or manually adjusting the color of your skin. Selecting a skin texture will automatically apply a color to your character's genitalia to match the chosen skin texture, but you can adjust it yourself if necessary.

[h3]Hair Styles and Colors[/h3]

You can now choose from a handful of beautiful and cool hair styles, as well as change the color of your hair and add some dye to it!

[b]Note:[/b] We only included a small amount of hair styles in this demo. Many more will be added throughout the Alpha and Beta testing phases. We will also be expanding on the dye system before launch, to allow you to add multiple dye colors and change the pattern/direction of the dye.

[h3]Eye Color[/h3]

No more bright cyan eyes! Now you can have whatever eye color you desire - even separate colors for each eye! The demo is limited to just colors, but the full game will have some even fancier eyes that have different textures/shapes and glowing effects.

[h3]Makeup[/h3]

Tired of having such a plain face? Spice it up with some fun makeup effects, including:

[list]
[*] Eyeliner
[*] Eyeshadow
[*] Blush
[*] Highlighter
[*] Lipstick
[/list]

Each option also allows you to customize the Color, Opacity, Shine, and Metallic-ness of the makeup.

As with the hair, [b]many[/b] more options will be added throughout Alpha and Beta.

[h3]Tattoos[/h3]

Now your character can show off some badass ink! Add tattoos to your Torso, Arms, Legs, or Face. And customize the Color (or use the color included in the tattoo itself), Opoacity, Shine, and Metallic-ness of each tattoo!

[b]Note:[/b] We actually went back and forth about whether or not to include the tattoos in this update. We want to improve on the system. Currently, there's only one "slot" per body part (torso, arm, etc.). We want to add more slots to place tattoos, but certain tattoos that are "sleeves" and cover up larger areas were being troublesome. So for now, the "slots" are limited, but we'll expand on it in the future. And of course, we'll be adding soooo many more tattoo designs over time.

[h3]Save & Load Updates[/h3]

Ever designed an awesome outfit and wanted to share it with your friends, but you don't want to share your entire character's customization including all the head and body settings? Well now you can save a specific section of settings! You can now save your Full Character, or [b]only[/b] the Head, Body, or Outfit settings separately!

[b]Note:[/b] This is an experimental system and might be changed or updated in the future. We know many of you want to be able to use your save files from this demo in the full game, and we're going to do our best to achieve that, but things might change too much between now and full launch. At the very least, the save files from this demo will work in Alpha 1.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

Below is a list of currently known issues, which will be fixed throughout testing and leading up to full launch.

[h3]Some of the shaping options in the Waist section break the genitalia.[/h3]

This problem has persisted from the initial version of the demo. We know how to fix it, it's just very tedious and time-consuming.

[h3]Why can't I change my Eyebrows or Eyelashes?[/h3]

Currently, the Eyebrows are tied to the chosen skin texture. That's just the way the texture files work. In the future, we will be separating the Eyebrows from the Skin, allowing you to choose whichever eyebrows you want. As for Eyelashes, we haven't decided how we want to handle those yet. There's no real "standard" way that Eyelashes work with DAZ assets. Some are simple textures, some are 3D meshes, and some should even be Grooms when converted to Unreal Engine. Once we figure out how _we_ want to handle eyelashes, that customization will be added to the game.

[h3]A Note on Performance[/h3]

Please note: [b]There is absolutely no performance optimization in this demo![/b] We want to see how this demo performs on various PC specs without any optimizations, so we can get a rough idea of how much optimization we'll need to do in the future. It seems to run fine if you have an nVidia 2070 or better, but if you're using a 1650 or something lesser, then you should expect it to lag a bit. If you do experience performance issues, please let us know what your hardware specs are!

Most of the performance drain comes from the ultra high quality hair we're currently using. This hair, known as "Groom" hair in UE, is notorious for being bad on performance, but it looks amazing. We plan on using this type of hair through Alpha 1, and then we may need to change it for something else if it proves to be too much for performance.

Another big hit to performance in this updated demo is a lot more textures being loaded in. If your GPU doesn't have a lot of VRAM, it could struggle. Again, we haven't done [u]any[/u] performance optimization yet. So don't worry too much if your PC is struggling currently. Performance will get much better during Beta testing.

[h2]Contests![/h2]

To celebrate the release of this demo, we have [b]three[/b] fun contests planned for our community! The first two, we did for the first version of the demo. They were so much fun, we decided to do them again!

The first contest will be to [b]Create the Most Attractive Character[/b]. Whether you're going for a beautiful face or a sexy body, show us how gorgeous you can make your character!

The second contest will be to [b]Create the Ugliest Character[/b]. We want you to break shit! Crank those shaping sliders to extreme values and show us the ugliest abomination you can conjure up!

The third contest will be to [b]Create a Celebrity Look-a-Like[/b]! Whoever can make their character look like a famous movie star (or fictional character) will win some cool prizes!

The first contest begins now! Start creating your most attractive character and then post it on our Discord in the thread in the Events channel. This contest will last 7 days. 3 lucky winners will receive 5,000 Revs when 3XO launches!

[h2]DOWNLOAD! TEST![/h2]

You can now download or update the Character Editor Demo right here on Steam.

Note - To enter/exit Full Screen, just hit F11. To exit the demo, you can hit F11 and close it, or hit ALT + F4. Some jackass (me) forgot to add the Exit button in the demo UI... [i]again[/i]...

notes.title: Character Editor Demo (v1) Available Now
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1 - Basic[/h1]

Please note: This is NOT the final version of the Character Editor!

This is "Version 1", a somewhat simplified and basic version that does not have all the features enabled. While we were polishing our Makeup and Tattoo systems, we discovered a brand new asset on the Unreal Engine marketplace specifically for converting Daz3D textures for use in UE. The product is amazing, and we will definitely be integrating parts of it into our own material systems. But this will take time. Rather than delaying the release of the CE demo, we decided to release a "basic" version now, with certain features disabled, and then release the updated full version sometime later.

This current version allows you to change your Body Type, Genitalia Type, and test out the hundreds of advanced shaping options. The full version, which we'll release later, will include all the features related to materials, such as - Skin Texture/Color, Eye Texture/Color, Hair Color, a few Clothing options (with Texture/Color settings), Nail Color (and possibly Texture), and other minor things.

For now, please play around with the huge amount of advanced shaping options. Your feedback is very important when it comes to these shaping options.

While testing, please think on some of these questions:

[*] Which options feel like they don't have enough of an effect and you think could be removed?

[*] The eyes vanish when rotating the character to the left. - This is due to some occlusion setting in the eye material, and will be fixed.
[*] There's a delay when changing Genitalia Types. - This is due to the widgets being destroyed/created when changing Genitalia, and will be fixed when we reformat our code in the full version.

notes.title: News Update 01
notes.content:
It's been over a month since our Kickstarter campaign ended, and a lot of you have been asking for more information on what us developers have been doing lately, so now is a good time to give everyone a little update. We have been very hard at work on polishing the Character Editor demo (which will be available soon, more info below) and continuing to optimize all of the clothing, hair, and other cosmetic customizations. We're going to try to post an update at least once a month, though it might be at different times each month. For this update, we've got some news about the upcoming Alpha 1 test, as well as the Character Editor demo, a fun new contest, and more.

[h2]Alpha 1[/h2]
I'm afraid we're going to start this update by getting the bad news out of the way first. We previously announced that the Alpha 1 test would begin on January 27th - that has sadly been delayed.

When we sat down to plan out the full testing roadmap, and decide where and when we wanted to test certain features in specific testing phases, we realized that we wanted to test certain features that required a persistent database a lot sooner - things like the Profiles, Friends List, etc. We weren't originally planning on building the database until Beta 1, but since we want to test those features a lot sooner, that means we need the database ready for Alpha 1 instead. It's no easy task to build a database that can scale to the needs of an MMO, and we want to make sure it's built very well without any bugs or connection issues, and that means it will take time.

So unfortunately, this means that Alpha 1 will not begin on January 27th. It will likely take another 2-3 months to make sure we have a proper database setup, as well as finishing those features that we want to test in the Alpha. On the bright side, this delay does mean that the Alpha 1 will be a much larger testing and gameplay experience with many more features than it was initially planned to have. This delay also means that people who missed the Kickstarter will still have a chance to get access to the Alpha, and we'll talk more about that in a bit.

[h2]Character Editor Demo[/h2]
Many of you are excited to get your hands on the Character Editor demo and finally see all the wonderful avatar customization options that 3XO will offer. Rest assured, it is coming very soon! We've been working very hard making sure it's as polished as it can be, as the character customization is the very core of the game, so it needs to work flawlessly and future-proofed, as it's the foundation that the rest of the game is built upon. Progress was slowed down a bit because of this cautionary approach, as we wanted to be as confident as possible that we won't have to make any big or breaking changes to this Character Editor further in development. We are now confident that the avatars you create in this demo will be able to be used when 3XO launches (or at least as confident as we can be).

We'll be releasing some previews and teasers of the Character Editor every few days building up to when the demo itself drops, which will be soon! And yes, the Character Editor demo will be available to everyone to download and play with.

[h3]Preview #1 - Lighting Options[/h3]
The first of our Character Editor previews showcases all the different Lighting options that you will be able to choose from, to see your avatar under different lights. These lighting options were designed by a professional photographer, and I have to say they look pretty great. The options include: Three-Point, Portrait, Split, Moonlight, Fireside, Pink Lantern, Red Light District, and Nightclub. Check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bY0Mv3RU-g8

[h2]Account Registration[/h2]
Some of you may have noticed already that it's now possible to register your account on our website. And for those of you that haven't noticed that yet - well here's your notice! Everybody should now [url=https://3xo.io/register]register an account[/url] so that you're ready for when things like the Character Editor demo are released or when Character Name Reservation opens up.

If you are a Kickstarter Backer, then you should automatically see your rewards listed on your account page. If you are a backer and do not see those rewards listed, then submit a support ticket on the website or Discord and we'll get it sorted. If you're not a Kickstarter Backer, then just ignore that section for now, and there will be more opportunities in the near future for you to support 3XO and get those same awesome rewards!

[h3]Character Name Reservation[/h3]
Originally, the Character Name Reservation was planned to open up shortly before Beta 1. But since we're planning on building the persistent database to use in Alpha 1, that means you'll be able to reserve your names a lot sooner! So shortly before Alpha 1 begins, we will open up the reservation process, which we will announce ahead of time so everybody can be prepared for it.

[h3]More Crowdfunding Options[/h3]
As we mentioned previously, we will be adding more crowdfunding opportunities to our own website soon. For those of you who missed the Kickstarter Campaign and have asked about how you can support 3XO, you will now be able to! The rewards and tiers will be very similar to the Kickstarter Campaign, the only real difference being different outfits in the various reward tiers. You'll still be able to get access to the Alpha and Beta tests and get special rewards like custom-designed outfits and more. These options will be available shortly after the Character Editor demo releases, so sometime within the next few weeks.

[h2]Chinese New Year Contest[/h2]
To wrap up our update, we've got a fun new contest! To celebrate the Chinese New Year, the Year of the Rabbit, we're having a contest to see who can make some amazing artwork. Are you ready to show us your art skills?

For this contest, we want to see your best depiction of what The Year of the Rabbit looks like in 3XO! Any art is acceptable, including AI-generated or terrible MS Paint doodles. Bonus points if it's sexy! Submit your art in the thread in our Events channel on Discord. Both the Black Lotus devs and the Community Staff will be judging this contest! Winners will be chosen in 72 hours (Thursday at 4pm EST).

The Prizes:
- 1st Place: 5,000 Revs

notes.title: Two Weeks Remain to Back on Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h1]Kickstarter Fully Funded - Only Two Weeks Remain![/h1]
We are now a full two weeks into our Kickstarter campaign! We reached our full funding goal in just 30 minutes! Then we went on to soar above that goal, reaching milestone after milestone. As of writing this, we are currently at over $38,000, having surpassed every stretch goal except for the final two. We are well on our way toward reaching that final $50k RPG Systems stretch goal, which will add incredibly powerful features to our World Builder system!

We want to extend a huge thank you to all of you who have backed thus far! Your support means the world to us. You have helped to make this game a reality, and we look forward to the upcoming testing phases and the future launch of 3XO!

You can show your support by backing us on Kickstarter, and getting some exclusive backer-only in-game rewards when the game launches! You can also get access to the upcoming Alpha and Beta tests!

The Kickstarter campaign can be found here - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/blacklotusgames/3xo-xxx-online-a-sexy-and-social-mmo-for-adults]3XO Kickstarter[/url]!

[h2]Reward Tiers[/h2]
We have a wide variety of reward tiers, so whether you want to support just a little bit or if you want to spend the big bucks to get some truly unique and exclusive rewards (including custom-designed outfits exclusive to YOU!), there's something for everyone.

Note that some of the highest tiers are limited in number - so act fast if you want those sexy rewards!

In addition to these listed rewards, there are a number of "Early Bird" tiers, which are identical to the standard tiers but at a special discounted price for the earliest supporters. They're also limited in number, so snag yours quickly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244500/72bc3a7d594659bc85bbe98d4a4dba52b2a5c3a1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Milestones[/h2]
There's also a number of milestones, or stretch goals, that will allow us to add more amazing content to the game before launch if we reach those goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43244500/1c243db9ef9679dc4adf770d245e059a79ecce78.jpg[/img]

[h2]How Can I Support?[/h2]
The main way you can support us is, of course, to back the campaign. Even the lowest backer tier is a big help. You'll also get some great rewards for supporting us early, such as in-game cosmetics or even some physical merch!

Another way you can support us is to help spread the word about the Kickstarter campaign. Share it on Twitter, tell your friends, heck even tell your grandmother! You can also wishlist 3XO on Steam (not available at this moment, but will be available by the time the Kickstarter campaign goes live) to help with those pesky algorithms.
